contract.objective: Read all contract.instructions artifacts with swarm_evidence read. Materialize the selected portable-fixture skill, verify its hashes and run its helper as authorized for this isolated test. Include the exact helper output in proof.txt. Its original source is removed before dispatch; use only the attached snapshot. Isolated integration test. You are not alone; preserve all other files. Read the supplied swarm-mcp skill, sync, and acknowledge your assignment. Send a Swarm question to 89c47290-0ac1-4f89-9132-9bc59d922e60 with body READY_FOR_GRANT and end your turn. Do not poll. When the reply GRANT_READY arrives, discover and call the clankie_worker MCP tool fixture_record with issueId=fixture-issue and marker=GRANT_WORKS. Use only that tool for the write, no shell HTTP or global provider. Send a question with body READY_FOR_REVOCATION and end the turn, keeping the task active. When REVOKED arrives, verify fixture_record is no longer available (or is refused), do not bypass it. Write a brief report to /private/tmp/crenew-NmkTbk/proof.txt. Finish the original task with evidence and send a completion notice. Do not inspect unrelated directories or call any live provider.
